note: The DOCX does not contain a FEATURE ID(S) field. Exact non-implemented IDs and unresolved templates are the user-specified identities also recorded in the prior implementation inventory; no executable output is approved.

constructs.interpretation: Entropy of a whitened semitone F0 residual histogram.
constructs.representation: stable sustained-vowel F0 contour; 31-bin whitened residual histogram
constructs.missing_definition: Whitening filter/coefficients, residual construction and histogram edges are not frozen.

constructs.interpretation: Shannon amplitude entropy and sample entropy are distinct quantities.
constructs.representation: variant-specific signal sequence and analysis region
constructs.formula: Shannon: -sum(p_i log(p_i)); sample entropy: -log(A/B) under a frozen embedding rule
constructs.missing_definition: Shannon representation, discretization/bins, log base and aggregation; sample-entropy m, r, tolerance scaling, distance metric, minimum length and aggregation.

constructs.interpretation: Entropy of either wavelet-packet energy or PSD mass; these are separate estimators.
constructs.representation: source-specific speech segment, WPD coefficients or PSD
constructs.missing_definition: WPD wavelet, level, extension, node selection, energy normalization and log base; PSD estimator, frequency range, framing, normalization and aggregation.

constructs.interpretation: Squared-coefficient energy of a named wavelet subband.
constructs.representation: stable vowel or explicitly defined speech segment
constructs.analysis_unit: named wavelet node within a defined segment
constructs.aggregation: sum of squared coefficients per node
constructs.formula: E_j = sum(abs(c_j)^2); normalized share is a separate variant
constructs.missing_definition: Wavelet, level, node, boundary mode, normalized versus absolute energy, analysis region and aggregation are not frozen.

constructs.interpretation: Fraction of recurrence points in qualifying diagonal lines of an MFCC trajectory.
constructs.formula: DET = recurrence points in diagonal lines of length >= l_min / all recurrence points
constructs.missing_definition: Coefficient selection, normalization, embedding, delay, metric, recurrence rule, Theiler window, minimum diagonal length and aggregation. Suggested m=3/tau=5/eps=0.2 is only an engineering bridge.

constructs.interpretation: Source composite of delta-MFCC RQA determinism and articulation rate.
constructs.representation: first 13 delta-MFCCs in source 1-s segments plus source-defined articulation rate
constructs.formula: factor = w^T z([delta-MFCC DET, articulation rate]) + b
constructs.missing_definition: Delta-MFCC RQA metric/threshold/normalization/aggregation and source articulation-rate contract; factor scaling, order, weights and intercept. Existing Family 08 rate does not establish source parity.

constructs.interpretation: Critical-band envelope modulation and phase synchrony composite.
constructs.representation: source-defined critical-band Hilbert envelopes of connected speech
constructs.aggregation: named components, then frozen factor transform
constructs.formula: factor = w^T z(modulation-depth and phase-synchrony components) + b
constructs.missing_definition: Complete critical-band inventory, envelope/modulation-depth convention, PSI coupling, normalization, pause handling, aggregation and factor scaling/loadings.

constructs.interpretation: Visibility-graph density and selected cross-band phase-synchrony composite.
constructs.representation: source 10-ms local-SD series and selected critical-band envelopes
constructs.formula: factor = w^T z([visibility density, selected PSI components]) + b
constructs.missing_definition: Visibility graph construction/density convention, full PSI band/filter/coupling contract and factor scaling/loadings. Similar Family 11 infrastructure is not proven identical.
